title: ClaudeWeb Plugin Manifest v2
description: Schema for ClaudeWeb Plugin Host v2 manifest.json (compatible with v1 manifests).

manifestVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Use 2 for Plugin Host v2 features.

minPluginApi.description: Minimum ClaudeWeb Plugin Host API version required (current host: 2).

requiredCapabilities.description: Host capability identifiers required by this plugin (e.g. slots:background, media-ticket, public-appearance-v1).

displayName.description: Human-readable name displayed in Settings -> Plugins.

description.description: Short summary shown on the plugin card.

icon.description: Relative path to an SVG icon inside the plugin directory (sanitized by host).

slot.description: Primary slot (retained for v1 compatibility; combine with `slots` in v2).

slots.description: All UI slots claimed by this plugin.

publicAppearance.description: Allows publishing host-verified, non-sensitive login-screen appearance snapshots.

entry.description: Relative POSIX path to the self-contained browser ES module entry.

server.description: Optional relative POSIX path to the Node.js local backend entry.

mode.description: Use "prebuilt" to skip npm install/build when committed artifacts exist and pass integrity verification; "auto" installs & builds when package.json is present.

integrity.description: SHA-256 integrity digests verified after install and update.

permissions.description: Declarative permission metadata for user review (not an OS sandbox).
